prompt: Design a high-fidelity 1440 by 1000 landscape desktop screen for Ovok’s CHF remote patient monitoring clinician dashboard. The setup register is read-only guidance with a clear connected / needs attention state, a tiny three-step progress list, and a calm link-style action to read setup instructions; it must not show switches, save buttons, alert thresholds, or settings editors. Show a clearly labeled single CHF clinic and no organization hierarchy. Queue below shows four synthetic patient rows with ECG / weight / questionnaire indicators and timestamps. The screen must look like an operational clinician dashboard with Signals readiness at a glance, not an admin console or a poster. Exact visible copy where possible: Ovok, Home, Patients, Signals setup, Help, CHF clinic, Demo workspace, Signals connected, Status from Ovok, Settings are read-only, Setup guide, Patient review, ECG, Weight, Check-in. Use Ovok’s established mobile palette and type exactly as visual identity guidance: near-white lavender canvas, deep purple #4B356D, lighter purple #694D98, pale lilac #F0EBF7, dark plum-black #24202D, soft white cards, gentle corner radius, crisp clean system sans typography. The supplied Ovok app screenshot contributes wordmark character, palette, rounded forms, and its quiet warm tone only. Translate those into spacious, information-dense web UI. Do not copy the phone frame, mobile home card, mobile tab bar, or text. Precise alignment, legible hierarchy, subdued dividers, accessible contrast. No gradients, glass effects, giant hero art, photographs, urgency claims, invented clinical thresholds, diagnosis, or additional clinics. All content is synthetic demo content.
